note: Mission 2 'The Orb Beneath the Ice' in-game lines (M9.O1 renders them). dur = slot in seconds. Line ids keep the ep1 numbering (L15 Whisper, L16-L17 Aldra). Speakers: narrator, vessa, torvald, pell, malrik, whisper, aldra (new in Speakers.TABLE).

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Glasswater Mere has not thawed in a hundred winters. Something at the bottom still shines.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: Malrik's diggers on Torvald's lake. Torvald must be thrilled.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: Two children, fighting on my lake. Finish it quickly, and leave my ice alone.

lines.speaker: pell
lines.text: You again! My wheels froze to the road, so I suppose I'm open. Take this, it's on the house. The house is frozen too.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: Pell's cart, and no Pell. Maybe I should have opened that cage. Well. Finders keepers.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: Emberguard, on your feet! Stamp a bit. Your toes will come back. Probably.

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.text: More diggers, more knives. You should have burned my hall when you had the chance.

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.text: Someone burned my barracks, so I brought fewer friends. Very petty. I respect it.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: Thin ice! Ha! I am absolutely doing that again.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: That ice has kept a secret for a hundred winters, ember. Think before you melt it.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: A hundred winters of ice, and it took me one afternoon. Somebody write that down.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: So be it. My lake will see you out. Slowly.

lines.speaker: aldra
lines.text: Through my glass already? Go, then. The mere remembers every footstep.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.text: Run, little ember. Every relic you carry makes the Hollow hungrier. You will see.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Two relics answer to fire. In the north, Ice watches, and says nothing.

lines.speaker: vessa
lines.text: Too... cold... should have... brought a coat...

lines.speaker: malrik
lines.text: Patience was never my virtue. Luckily, I brought shovels.
